- **Choose your folders in Manager on TrueNAS and Docker (FL-1311):** a new TrueNAS install now needs one edit, the name of your pool, and a new Docker install needs none. You pick where photos, the database and backups go during setup, and Manager creates the folders for you. Installs you already have keep their folders.
- **Choose your folders in Manager on Unraid (FL-1308):** new Unraid installs pick their folders in Manager instead of in the template. External folders adds an existing photo folder to Frameleaf without editing the template.
- **Clearer Add a folder messages (FL-1308):** Add a folder now tells you whether Frameleaf can't see a folder or isn't allowed to open it.
- **Progress while scanning folders (FL-1309):** Frameleaf shows progress while it walks through a large library folder.
- **Back to where you were on Explore (FL-1312):** going back to Explore from a search now returns you to the same place on the page, even when the page takes a moment to fill in.
- **Manager says what's wrong, all at once (FL-1316, FL-1317, FL-1318):** Check this server now lists every problem in one go, including room for Frameleaf, downloads, a port another app is using and memory. When Docker fails, Manager says what happened and what to do in plain words.
- **Fast drives for the database and thumbnails (FL-1319, FL-1320, FL-1321, FL-1322, FL-1323, FL-1325):** Manager shows which drive each folder is on and how much room it has, and suggests a fast drive for the database and for thumbnails. The Storage page moves the database or thumbnails to another drive after install and helps when the thumbnails drive goes missing. The plain Docker launcher can add more drives.
- **Low-space warnings for every drive (FL-1324):** Frameleaf now warns you when the drive with your thumbnails or database runs low on room, not only the photos drive.
- **Faster on large libraries (FL-1331, FL-1335, FL-1336):** the library, Explore and Library analytics open much sooner on libraries with many thousands of photos.
- **Move to… and several albums at once (FL-1332):** Move to… opens straight away even with thousands of albums. On the Albums page, Select lets you move, merge, lock or delete several albums together, and one Undo brings back a merge.
- **Keep best copy finishes on big duplicate sets (FL-1330):** Keep best copy in all no longer stops after a few hundred photos.
- **A move never overwrites a file (FL-1333):** when Frameleaf moves or sorts a file, it never replaces a file already in its place, and an original is removed only once its copy is proven identical.
- **Import notifications can be cleared (FL-1313, FL-1314):** notifications from an import can now be marked as read and dismissed, and the notification list opens faster.
- **Tidier dropdowns (FL-1328):** every dropdown shows one arrow with room beside it, with spacing fixes across many screens.
- **Frameleaf Desktop runs more models (FL-1329):** a computer with Frameleaf Desktop can now help with more of the Visual search, People and text models you can choose, including Best for Visual search.
- **A password for your own server (FL-713):** when the owner of a library linked to a Frameleaf account signs in with Frameleaf and has no password on this server yet, Frameleaf asks them to set one.
- **Locked stays private in preservation exports (FL-1344):** preservation exports and restores follow your current Locked choices for tags, people and pets, and their summaries and Activity never give away hidden items.
- **Your own monitoring, if you want it (FL-822):** Frameleaf can share how it's running with Prometheus and Grafana on your own network, with a ready-made dashboard. It stays off unless you turn it on.
- **Damaged photos repair themselves (FL-1337, FL-1338):** when a photo won't open, Frameleaf repairs it by itself where it can. The damaged file is kept beside the repaired one, and Undo puts it back. You can turn this off and choose each repair yourself.
- **Missing photos come back (FL-1337, FL-1338):** Frameleaf looks for a missing original by its contents, not its name, on this server's drives and in Cloud Backup.
- **What happened to each file (FL-1337, FL-1338):** Library care › Damaged and missing files lists every problem file with a What happened history of everything Frameleaf tried, sorted into Needs you, Fixed for you and Left as they are.
- **The Overview says what was fixed (FL-1338):** the Overview tells you how many photos Frameleaf fixed last night or this week, and which ones still need you.
- **The viewer flags a missing or damaged original (FL-1338):** a photo whose original is missing or damaged is marked in the viewer, with See what happened.
- **Unfinished work is finished overnight (FL-811):** during the Overnight schedule, Frameleaf looks for photos and videos still missing their details, previews, playback copies, Visual search, faces or text, and finishes them. You can turn it off in Overnight settings.
- **Recent server logs kept for support (FL-870):** Frameleaf keeps a short, rotated record of its recent logs on your server, with passwords and email addresses removed, so an administrator can look at or download them when something goes wrong.
